class.name: LocalLRTVolume3D
class.brief_description: Builds local LRT geometry and static SH4 lighting fields.
class.description: Builds dense signed distance and linear diffuse color fields for participating MeshInstance3D nodes. In Forward+ it injects visibility-tested, multi-bounce diffuse lighting and an occluded Godot Sky boundary into standard material ambient diffuse lighting.

method.name: bake
method.description: Rebuilds the fields from participating meshes under the volume's parent.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears baked data and debug geometry.

method.name: clear_lighting
method.description: Replaces the current SH4 field with black while retaining geometry, transport links, and direct-light injection data.

method.name: get_field_summary
method.description: Returns grid sizes, classified cell counts, and aggregate lighting energy for validation.

method.name: inject_first_bounce
method.description: Recomputes native-light injection, local visibility links, and the first SH4 propagation step.

method.name: propagate
method.description: Runs additional GPU propagation iterations using the current static transport links and direct-light injection.

method.name: sample_first_bounce
method.description: Samples the linear receiver irradiance divided by pi at a volume-local position.

method.name: sample_sdf
method.description: Samples the signed distance at a volume-local position.

method.name: sample_sky_visibility
method.description: Evaluates the cosine-weighted Sky boundary visibility at a volume-local position and normal.

method.name: sample_nearest_surface
method.description: Returns signed distance, normal, linear color, and owner ID from the same nearest surface seed.

method.name: sample_surface_color
method.description: Samples linear diffuse color from an occupied color cell.
